items: What alerted the jinn to the death of Sulayman while he leaned on his staff?
A creature of the earth eating the staff so he fell
He died leaning on his staff; when a creature ate it he fell and the jinn realised he was dead.
How did Sulayman invite the Queen of Sheba to Islam?
With a letter sent by the hoopoe
With a call from a mountain
He sent a letter with the hoopoe.
In which surah is the Queen of Sheba's throne brought in the blink of an eye?
Surah An-Naml tells how her throne was brought before Sulayman's glance returned.
Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish?
Yunus left his people in anger and was swallowed by the fish.
What prayer did Yunus make in the belly of the fish?
'No god but You, glory to You; I was a wrongdoer'
'Our Lord, give us good in this world'
He called out in the darkness with this supplication.
Which prophet is called 'Dhun-Nun' (the Man of the Fish) in the Quran?
Which prophet took Maryam under his care?
Zakariyya cared for Maryam and found provision with her in the sanctuary.
Who was the father of Yahya (John)?
In old age Zakariyya was given Yahya in answer to his prayer.
Maryam's mother is called the wife of whom in the Quran?
Maryam's mother is mentioned as the wife of Imran; she vowed her child to God.
Which tree did Maryam lean against during childbirth?
The pains of labour took her to the trunk of a date palm.
What did Isa say in the cradle?
He said: 'Indeed I am the servant of God; He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.'
Which miracle did God perform through Isa?
Raising the dead by God's leave
He raised the dead and healed the blind and the leper, by God's leave.
What are Isa's close followers called in the Quran?
What did the disciples ask Isa to have sent down from heaven?
They asked for a table from heaven; the surah takes its name from it.
What is Dhul-Qarnayn best known for in the Quran?
Building a barrier against Gog and Magog
He built a barrier of iron and copper against Ya'juj and Ma'juj.
For how many years did the People of the Cave sleep?
Surah Al-Kahf says they stayed three hundred years and added nine.
Which animal was with the People of the Cave?
Their dog lay at the entrance with its paws stretched out.
According to the hadith, who is the servant of God with whom Musa travelled in Surah Al-Kahf?
The hadith identifies the knowledgeable servant as al-Khidr.
How many prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran?
Names of the prophets in the Quran
Twenty-five prophets are mentioned by name.
Which of these prophets is not among the 'Ulul-'Azm' (those of firm resolve)?
The scholars list Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa and Muhammad.
How does the Quran describe the raising of Isa?
How does the Quran describe Idris?
God raised him to a high station
He was exiled to the desert
'And We raised him to a high station.'
Which prayer did Musa make to ask God to open his heart?
'My Lord, expand for me my chest'
As he was sent to Pharaoh he asked: 'My Lord, expand my chest and ease my task.'
Which event from Musa's life is told in Surah Al-Qasas?
His birth and upbringing in Pharaoh's palace
Al-Qasas tells of his birth, upbringing and prophethood.
What title does Musa carry because God spoke to him directly?
What title is given to Isa in connection with the 'Spirit from God'?
The verse calls Isa the Messenger of God, His word and a spirit from Him.
From what material was Adam created according to the Quran?
God told the angels He would create a human from clay.
Because of the scheming of the governor's wife
Because he complained about his brothers
She falsely accused him and he was jailed despite signs of his innocence.
In which surah does a prophet interpret the dreams of two fellow prisoners?
Surah Yusuf recounts the interpretation of the two prisoners' dreams.
For which transgression were a group of Israelites turned into apes?
The people of the seaside town broke the Sabbath rule and were transformed.
Who warned her people in the Valley of the Ants?
An ant said: 'O ants, enter your dwellings.'
What act of worship did the mountains and birds join Dawud in?
The mountains and birds glorified God with Dawud morning and evening.
Which idol did Prophet Ilyas rebuke his people for worshipping?
He said: 'Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators?'
Which place with 'lofty pillars' is mentioned in connection with 'Ad?
Surah Al-Fajr mentions 'Iram, possessors of lofty pillars'.
How were the believers punished in the story of the People of the Trench?
They were thrown into blazing pits of fire
They were drowned in the sea
The surah condemns those who burned believers in trenches.
Why was the owner of the two gardens in Surah Al-Kahf destroyed?
He grew arrogant and denied the Hereafter, so his garden was ruined.
How did Nuh's people treat him as he built the Ark?
Whenever the leaders passed by, they ridiculed him.
How did Salih describe his she-camel to his people?
He said: 'This is God's she-camel, a sign for you.'
Which prophet built the Kaaba together with his father?
Ibrahim and Ismail raised the foundations of the House.
Who is considered the first prophet?
Adam, the first human, is generally considered the first prophet.
Who is the last of the prophets?
'But he is the Messenger of God and the Seal of the Prophets.'
Which of these prophets is not a descendant of Ibrahim?
Nuh lived before Ibrahim; the others descend from him.
What punishment seized the people of Shu'ayb?
The earthquake seized them and they lay motionless in their homes.
In which surah is Zakariyya's prayer for a child told?
Surah Maryam tells how he called upon his Lord secretly and was given Yahya.
What punishment fell on the people of Saba' for their ingratitude?
The flood of the dam destroyed their gardens.
What did God send against Abraha's army?
He sent flocks of birds that pelted them with stones of baked clay.
What food was sent down to the Israelites in the wilderness?
God shaded them with clouds and sent down manna and quails.
How many springs gushed from the rock when Musa struck it with his staff?
Twelve springs gushed forth, and each tribe knew its drinking place.
What did Ibrahim serve his angel guests?
He soon brought a roasted calf.
How did Maryam respond to her people after Isa was born?
She vowed silence and pointed to the baby
She said she had vowed a fast and would not speak to anyone, and pointed to the baby, who spoke.
